open: No lockers or ticket office listed by DSB.
Fratelli Kolding and Freddy's Cafe (OSM, next to the station, not tagged as in the station building) not included.
OSM does not flag the 7-Eleven and DSB toilet nodes as inside the station building (18 m / 45 m away); position words unconfirmed.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.

answers.question: OSM has only platform 1 (ref 1); perron 2 (spor 2/3) is not in the extract, so which lift/stairs reach it is unsettled.
answers.answer: Lifts serve perron 2 (spor 2/3) (Perron 2 is in the raw OSM extract (r11605681 ref 2;3). Lift n1327227762, with its building w106001604, lies inside it between the track 2 and track 3 lines. n1327227784/w106041802 serves perron 1.)
